props.reason: Pastrnak is Boston's top playmaking threat and runs the top power-play unit, giving him multiple high-quality assist chances each night. A plus-money or near-even line on a star producing at an elite point rate offers solid value.

McAvoy leads Boston's blue line in minutes and shot attempts, often jumping into the rush and firing from the point on the power play. This usage makes clearing 1.5 shots a near coin-flip plus favorable price.
